for the true end follows when the great eye closes. |release_version = 3.20.0 |is_drop_restricted = true |drop_text = Drops from [[Uber Exarch]]. }} '''Annihilation's Approach''' is a pair of [[unique]] {{il|Dragonscale Boots}}. ==Modifiers== {{c|mod|Grants Level 20 Approaching Flames Skill}}: {{sl|Approaching Flames}} is a skill granted by this unique. It is an [[instant]] [[spell]] and [[buff]] with a 5 second cooldown; using this skill will toggle the {{c|mod|Flame-Touched}} buff on you. The buff can also be turned off by {{c|mod|Removes all Burning when used}} flasks. {{stl|Adrenaline (buff)|Adrenaline}} is not lost when reduced to 1 life, only on losing the "flame-touched" status, i.e. toggling the Approaching Flames skill off. However, while allocating the [[Champion]] Ascendancy Notable [[First to Strike, Last to Fall]], Approaching Flames will turn off automatically after turning it on with the skill going on cool down. It will however heal you for 25% of maximum life. Despite being an instant spell with a cooldown, Approaching Flames can not be supported by [[Automation Support]]. {{Item acquisition}} ==Legacy variants== Annihilation's Approach has a [[legacy variant]]. {{legacy variant table header}} {{legacy variant table row|3.23.0| * Grants Level 20 Approaching Flames Skill * (60-100)% increased Armour and Evasion * 30% increased Movement Speed * Cannot be Chilled * Cannot be Frozen * {{c|mod|Take 10000 Fire Damage per Second while Flame-Touched}} * Gain Adrenaline when you become Flame-Touched * Lose Adrenaline when you cease to be Flame-Touched }} {{Legacy variant table end}} ==Design attribution== Annihilation's Approach was created in a collaboration with [https://www.pathofexile.com/account/view-profile/nickexile11-5507/ nickexile11 (imexile)] as a reward for taking a prize place in the 3.18 boss kill event.https://twitter.com/imexilepoe/status/1601285976726249472 ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * The Fire Damage taken per Second while Flame-Touched on the Annihilation's Approach Unique Boots was a bit too high for a Unique obtained through killing an Uber Pinnacle Boss. As such, we have updated these Boots to have "Take 6000 Fire Damage per Second while Flame-Touched" (previously 10000). A Divine Orb can be used on existing items to obtain this new value. }} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web |author=Community_Team |date=May 23, 2022 |title=Sentinel Boss Kill Event Announcement |url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3273445 |publisher=Official Path of Exile Forums |accessdate=August 8, 2022 }} }} {{Navbox Unique Items}}
